name: Pluxee N.V.
summary: Pluxee N.V. offers employee benefits and engagement solutions services in France, Latin America, Continental Europe, and internationally. The company offers employee benefits comprising meal, food, gift, mobility, training, insurance, and wellness benefits as well as engagement solutions; health, mental and physical well-being, leisure and culture, hybrid work, training, and uniforms; and other products and services, including rewards and recognition, public benefits, and fuel, fleet and expense management solutions.
